note: Hand-written, language-neutral. The declared home of every realtime event `type` a browser reads off a `user:` or `tenant:` channel (ADR-0036 amendment 2026-09-14, C-08). Read by txnet-backend/shared-core/src/lib/automation/routing-keys.contract.spec.ts, which holds OutboxEventType to it, and by tools/wire-gen.py, which generates site-pwa/src/generated/wire.ts from it.

realtimeEvents.note: Each is also the outbox event type that produced it: the worker's consumer republishes the producing domain's event under the same name — except a DirectRealtimeEventType (routing-keys.ts), which its service publishes itself.
